steps.t: Lock in one clean save file: never enter a cheat code on your trophy run, because cheats disable trophies and saving for the session.
Make a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — there is no mission replay and no New Game+.
Play the story first and let the 13 story trophies unlock on their own; free roam stays open after the credits.
After the credits, open Touchpad > Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist down line by line.
Finish every Strangers & Freaks strand and all five character questlines: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.
Clear the collectible counters in this ledger — stunts, scans, card sets, challenges — before chasing one-off feats.
Re-check the trophy list for stragglers; the Platinum pops the moment the 54th other trophy lands.
On Xbox the same finish is the 0G Mythic achievement, so this route serves both platforms.
Turn on every progress and collectible notification in Settings at the start, so counters surface as you play.
Expect the run to split roughly into story (60–80h), checklist (about 100h) and cleanup (about 10h).

disputes.q: How long does the Platinum actually take?
disputes.a: Most trackers budget roughly 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist.
disputes.b: Push Square tells players to set aside up to 300 hours or more.
disputes.call: Budget 200 hours and treat anything beyond that as buffer for the checklist grind.

steps.t: Start a new game and play Jason's opening missions in Chapter 1.
Take the boat out when the story sends you on the Gone Fishing trip.
Finish the fishing trip; the trophy pops as the mission closes.
Make your first manual save right after it pops — you will want a Chapter 1 save for the meditation window.
Keep playing Chapter 1 normally; this trophy cannot be missed.
Gone Fishing is one of the first missions of Chapter 1, so this lands inside your first hour.
It is one of 13 story trophies, and none of the 13 can be missed.
Work through Chapter 1's story missions in order.
Before ending the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
Bank a manual save in a fresh slot at the chapter's end.
Play the first mission of Chapter 2 — the Chapter 1 trophy pops as the next chapter opens.
Confirm the pop before overwriting any Chapter 1 save.
The first Chapter 2 mission is What's in the Bag? — the trophy is tied to starting it, not to ending Chapter 1.
Chapter trophies behave this way throughout: expect each to land as the next chapter opens.

disputes.q: When exactly does the chapter trophy pop?
disputes.a: PowerPyx notes it unlocks when you play the first Chapter 2 mission, not on the Chapter 1 finale cutscene.
disputes.b: List pages print only 'Complete Chapter 1' with no timing note at all.
disputes.call: Do not panic at a silent cutscene — play one mission into Chapter 2.

steps.t: Push through Chapter 2's missions; partner switching opens during this chapter.
Start calling your partner in during free roam — the partner trophies go live from here.
Do Billy's first Thrillbilly jobs when they appear in Kelly County.
Finish the chapter's final mission to close Chapter 2.
Save at the chapter break before starting Chapter 3 content.
This one is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.
Use Chapter 2 to start Kenton's resumed chain and Billy's jobs while the story carries you past them.
Continue the story into Chapter 3 and finish its mission chain in order.
Unlock the Key Cloner during Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — several later feats depend on it.
Run Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to earn the Snap Gun for Sneakthief.
Start Randy's Wish List deliveries from the green RK marker west of Vice City.
Close out the chapter's last mission; free roam remains open for cleanup.
Bank a chapter-end save before Chapter 4's heist chain begins.
The trophy arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Chapter 3 is the unlocking chapter: Key Cloner, Snap Gun and the Dye Pack Jammer all arrive here.
Finish the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Play Child's Play and Headliners as they arrive — each carries its own trophy.
Complete VCIA Takedown when it appears in the chain.
Take the optional cafe mission That's Where The Money Is… to open the bank vaults.
Finish Starting From Zero, the chapter's closing mission.
Save before moving into Chapter 5 — the endgame narrows your windows.
Like the other chapter trophies, this cannot be missed — it is a pure story beat.
Chapter 4 is the money chapter: vaults open here and fund the garage and laundering grinds.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Before starting the finale, park a manual save in its own slot — there is no mission replay afterwards.
Finish Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5 on the way to the finale.
Start the final story mission when you are ready to close the campaign.
Play the final mission through to the credits.
Stay in free roam after the credits — every remaining trophy stays available.
No trophy depends on how you play a mission — there are no mission medals or replay requirements anywhere in the list.

disputes.q: What is this trophy's official description?
disputes.a: Most lists print it as 'Complete the final mission.'
disputes.b: Insider Gaming prints 'Complete Chapter 5', and EGamers notes other outlets word it as Chapter 5 too.
disputes.call: Same trigger either way: finish the last story mission.

disputes.q: Which chapter hosts the final mission?
disputes.a: PowerPyx's roadmap text calls Starting From Zero the final main mission in Chapter 4.
disputes.b: The same guide's own list places Operation Savage Glory and the finale in Chapter 5.
disputes.call: Treat Chapter 5 as the endgame; the Chapter 4 line reads like a roadmap slip.

steps.t: Play Chapter 2 until the Breakfast Run mission starts.
Run the mission with Jason and Lucia together — it teaches partner play.
Finish the mission; character switching opens around this point of the chapter.
From here, call your partner in with Right + Triangle whenever a partner trophy is on deck.
Bank a save — Hot Together and Retail Therapy are now within reach.
Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 mission; the trophy is a pure story beat.
Everything partner-based in this ledger unlocks across Chapter 2, so route those trophies from here on.

disputes.q: When does duo play actually open?
disputes.a: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run.
disputes.b: PowerPyx ties free-roam partner play to the later Coffee Break mission.
disputes.call: Story switching starts at Breakfast Run; free-roam partner calls wait for Coffee Break.

steps.t: Reach Chapter 3 and play until The Cartel Heist appears.
Run the heist mission to its end — this is a story beat, not a free-roam robbery.
Let the trophy pop at the mission's close before starting side work.
Keep a save before the heist if you want a clean chapter for collectible routing.
Note the difference: free-roam bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal only open in Chapter 4.
The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission, distinct from the free-roam vault jobs of Chapter 4.
It is one of 13 unmissable story trophies.
Play Chapter 4 until Child's Play comes up in the chain.
Complete the mission in full; it cannot be missed or failed permanently.
Sweep the mission area's WAiNK spots before leaving the zone.
Save at the next chapter beat.
Move on to Headliners — the DWNFALL trophy is next in this stretch.
Child's Play sits in Chapter 4's chain, between the chapter's opening pair and Headliners.
It cannot be missed; no story trophy can.
Play Chapter 4 until Headliners appears in the mission chain.
Complete the mission — it is story-locked and cannot be missed.
Let the trophy register before diving into side content.
Sweep nearby WAiNK spots while the mission area is open.
Save at the next safe point; VCIA Takedown follows in this chapter.
Keep your Chapter 4 start save untouched until the chapter closes.
Headliners is a Chapter 4 mission; expect this right after Family Matters in the chain.
Bank a save after it — VCIA Takedown and the vault unlock both live in this chapter.
Reach VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4's mission chain.
Run the airport mission to completion.
Note the airport layout while you are here — you will return for Catch Me If You Can.
Finish the mission and confirm the pop.
Save before leaving the airport district.
Remember the gates: E3 and E4 matter again for the jet theft feat.
VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 mission — the airport becomes familiar ground for two later feats.
It is unmissable, like every story trophy.
Enter Chapter 5 and play until Operation Savage Glory starts.
Complete the operation in full.
Bank a save immediately — the finale is close now.
Finish any Chapter 5 cleanup before starting the final mission.
Confirm the pop, then roll into the endgame.
Keep your pre-finale save in its own slot until the Platinum is done.
Operation Savage Glory is Chapter 5's named mission trophy — the last before the finale itself.
After this, only the final mission stands between you and the credits.
Finish the story first — the checklist only appears afterwards at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Trust your earlier work: progress earned before the credits already counts toward the list.
Clear every robbery line: 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, plus the bank and Payday Loan jobs.
Dive out the underwater discoveries scattered around the coast.
Gold every shooting range challenge — all 42 medals are required in full.
Win the drone board: all 42 Top Fun time trials across the 14 locations.
Finish all 15 of Bret's Target Deck hunts.
Complete 100 optional missions — far more exist than required, so pick the short ones.
Scan 200 of the 277 base vehicle models with WAiNK as you travel.
Study 100 of the 255 animal species through binoculars: hold L1, zoom with Up, hold R1.
Bank the partial targets: 15 meditations, 70 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans.
Fence the money lines: marked bills, narcotics, jewelry and vehicles all carry checklist totals.
Stop at the checklist numbers — 100% here is roughly 60% of everything the game tracks.
Nothing on the checklist is missable, so no earlier save can rescue or ruin this trophy.
Use an interactive checklist or this ledger's counters to tick lines off as they fall.

disputes.q: How much of the game is '100%' really?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and EGamers put it at roughly 60% of true completion, with partial targets everywhere.
disputes.b: Push Square tells players they have to do 'almost everything'.
disputes.call: Follow the numeric checklist, not the rhetoric — the partial targets are real.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see the four stunt families on your map.
Farm Under-the-Bridge flights first — guides rate them the quickest stunt type to repeat.
Work Stunt Jumps next — there are 130 of them across ramps, bridges and construction sites.
Thread Knife Flights (40) between Vice City's towers in a nimble plane.
Save Base Jumps (25) for when you are crossing the map anyway.
Check Progress > Activities > Stunts and press R3 to audit your per-region totals.
If a jump keeps failing, change vehicle class before changing route — some jumps demand specific vehicles.
Push past the trophy to 300 stunts if you are also closing the 100% checklist.
The optional challenge attached to each stunt is not required — only the stunt itself counts.
Stunt work also feeds the checklist's stunt line, so every stunt does double duty.

disputes.q: Is the target 250 or 300 stunts?
disputes.a: The trophy itself stops at 250 of the 397 stunts in the game.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist demands 300, so stopping at 250 leaves checklist debt.
disputes.call: Route for 300 from the start; the trophy pops on the way.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see the nine activity types the game tracks.
Filter the map to Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find venues near you.
Fish once from any boat or pier spot.
Hunt once — a single tracked hunt ticks the type.
Play a round of golf at any course.
Play one game of pool at any table.
Sink one hoop at a basketball court to register Basketball.
Shoot one challenge at any shooting range.
Finish one arcade or TV video game session.
Win any one race — car race, race challenge or drone race.
Perform any single stunt, then re-open the Activities page and confirm all nine types show progress.
Most of the nine types complete naturally as the story introduces them.
The same nine types reappear on the checklist in bigger doses — golds, wins and plays — so early ticks save later hunts.

disputes.q: What exactly are the nine activity types?
disputes.a: PowerPyx enumerates nine, counting 'Win a Race' and 'Perform a Stunt' as types of their own.
disputes.b: Other lists confirm the count of nine but never enumerate them.
disputes.call: Use PowerPyx's nine as the working list and verify on the Activities page.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.t: Filter the map to Activities > Shooting Ranges to reveal the range locations.
Start at Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and clear its challenge tiers.
Move to Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero and repeat.
Chase gold on every tier — most challenges stack three difficulty levels.
Some challenges stay locked until you meet side conditions shown on the map; clear those first.
Use range sessions to raise your Focus stat while you grind medals.
Audit the medal count at Touchpad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.
Stop only when the count reads 42 golds — the checklist requires every single one too.
Range work raises your Focus level, which pays off directly in Gunslinger.
The checklist demands all 42 golds as well — there is no partial-credit route here.

disputes.q: How many shooting ranges are there?
disputes.a: PowerPyx counts 12 shooting ranges holding the 42 gold medals between them.
disputes.b: Push Square and OutputLag describe two range locations whose challenges hold the 42 golds.
disputes.call: Locations versus individual ranges — either way, the medal target is 42.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.t: Open the map filter Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones to mark the 14 locations.
Pay the entry fee where a location charges one.
Win one race at the first location to learn the drone handling.
Bank one win at every location — repeats at the same spot do not advance the trophy.
Track the location count in your Progress until all 14 show a win.
If you are chasing 100%, stay and clear all 42 races instead of just the 14 wins.
Leave the hardest course for last, when your drone lines are practiced.
Finish each location's full race set while you are there; returning 14 times costs more than staying.
Drone races also count as the race type for Master of None if you still need it.

disputes.q: One win per location, or every race?
disputes.a: For the trophy, one win at each of the 14 locations is enough.
disputes.b: The completion checklist wants all 42 races done, not 14.
disputes.call: Win 14 for the trophy; finish 42 if the checklist is next.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Activities > Racing to list the race spots you have found.
Enter races in a hired car when your own car's Rating is low.
Upgrade your car at a Mod Shop before bringing it to harder races.
Win a race, then move on — winning the same race twice does not count.
Mark each won location off your list as you travel between story beats.
Keep crossing off new locations until the counter reaches 20 different wins.
On a Platinum run, keep going to 30 unique wins for the checklist.
The checklist separately wants 10 of 13 Race Challenge gold medals — chase golds on the races you win.
There are 40 races in total, so 20 different wins is exactly half the board.

disputes.q: Is the target 20 or 30 race wins?
disputes.a: The trophy needs 20 different race wins out of the 40 races in the game.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist raises the bar to 30 unique wins.
disputes.call: Aim for 30 unique wins and both targets fall.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal) to meet Cal Hammond.
Wait for Cal's text, then head to the purple icon west of Key Lento.
Run Cal's fishing errand first if he asks — the challenge follows it.
Take a boat with a fishing rod; hijack one nearby if you have none of your own.
Fish the marked area until you land a Parrotfish over 2kg.
Beat Cal's challenge result to pop the trophy.
If the fish will not bite, reposition the boat inside the marked zone and try again.
This also ticks the Fishing type for Master of None.
Cal's spot is in the Key Lento area — combine the trip with Kenton's first dives nearby.

disputes.q: How does Cal's challenge actually start?
disputes.a: PowerPyx routes it as a quest first: meet Cal, take his text, then work his fishing job at Key Lento.
disputes.b: Push Square frames it as a direct request: catch a Parrotfish over 2kg in the marked area.
disputes.call: Do the errand, then fish the marked water for a 2kg+ Parrotfish — both readings converge there.

steps.t: From Chapter 1, turn on the TV at Jason's house to reach the home games.
Pick one of Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind.
Play that single game through all of its levels — finishing one game is the whole requirement.
Alternatively, find a Bang For Your Buck cabinet in the world and clear it instead.
Confirm the trophy after the game's final level, not mid-run.
For the checklist, note the completion list also wants all four video games played.
For the checklist, all four video games must be played — sample the other three while you are here.
Reach the end of one game; starting all four is not the same as completing one.

disputes.q: Do the home TV games count as 'arcade games'?
disputes.a: PowerPyx counts the three TV games at home plus the Bang For Your Buck cabinets — four games in all.
disputes.b: The trophy text says 'arcade game', and some lists only promise that any of the four in-game games counts.
disputes.call: Safest is a full clear of one title, TV or cabinet.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.t: Play as Lucia — Andy's chain is Lucia-only.
Look for Andy's mark in Chapter 3, then call him and answer his text with the Belville address.
Work the chain in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Parts 1 to 3.
Continue with Pay the Cellerica Fee.
Run Peach! next — Andy's fourth quest in the chain.
Finish Read the Label, then close the chain with Puff Puff Pass.
If you missed the first window, keep playing — the chain is reported to stay available after the story.
Andy's chain is not part of the 100% checklist — it is Strangers & Freaks territory only.
The five quests are quick; the whole chain fits inside one Chapter 3 session.

disputes.q: Can Andy's chain be left until after the story?
disputes.a: PowerPyx says Andy's quests remain available after the story ends.
disputes.b: EGamers relays a single-source warning that stranger chains have story-linked windows.
disputes.call: Start the chain when it appears in Chapter 3; do not bank on the post-story safety net.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.t: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, find the green KR icon for Kenton Rees in Key Lento.
Dive the marked shipwrecks and sweep each wreck with the metal detector for purple chests.
Track finds at Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
Expect a gap: the chain pauses after Chapter 1 and resumes across Chapters 2 and 3.
If progress stalls, call Brian — it can hurry Kenton's next text to Jason.
Finish the final dive mission, Maritime Disputes, to close the chain.
Count your treasure sets as you go — the checklist later wants 5 of Kenton's 7 sets.
Kenton's Treasures also feed the checklist, which wants 5 of his 7 treasure sets.
His chain is not part of the strand count for Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy instead.

disputes.q: Does the Chapter 1 pause mean the chain can be lost?
disputes.a: PowerPyx warns the chain is unavailable after Chapter 1 until it returns later — easy to mistake for a glitch.
disputes.b: Roundups of the list treat all side-story finales as safe to finish after the credits.
disputes.call: Start it in Chapter 1, expect the pause, and finish it by Chapter 3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.t: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Start Billy's chain with Thrillbillies.
Continue through Twist Wrist Smash Grab.
Work Mall Rats next.
Run The Impaler, Billy's fourth job in the chain.
Close the chain with Hometown Heroes — the trophy pops on that finale.
Billy's chain is not part of the 100% checklist.
The Mudclub sits in Kelly County — the same county as the Ambrosia tunnel used for Hot Together escapes.

disputes.q: Do Billy's jobs survive the end of the story?
disputes.a: GTA Zone says Billy's five jobs stay open after the story.
disputes.b: EGamers passes on a one-source caution that stranger chains can have story windows.
disputes.call: They are listed as post-story safe, but starting them in Chapter 2 costs nothing.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.t: Use the in-trophy tracker: open the trophy list and watch the strand counter after each finale.
Run Kirk's strand: Search for the Skunk Ape, then Search for Tree Effigies.
Finish Kirk's line with Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove.
Run Kyle's strand: Check Out McKittrick Farm, then Collect Chemicals for Kyle.
Close Kyle's line with Buddy?.
Run Yago's strand: Join a Street Race, then Bumper to Bumper.
Save before Race Against Yago — it is a timed, one-shot race — then finish with Brother to Brother.
Run Pilot Pete's The Last Mile: Passing the Torch and Backseat Pilot.
Fly Pete's Deliveries: Southpoint Airfield and Avery Allen & Co.
Finish Pete's line with Deliver Packages.
Stop at eight counted strands — chains with their own trophies (Andy, Billy, Tyrone) do not advance this counter.
Strands are not part of the 100% checklist at all — this trophy stands alone.
All strands stay available after the story, so a missed strand is a delay, not a loss.

disputes.q: Which strands actually count toward the eight?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTA Zone name the counting givers — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete — and list Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie as non-counters.
disputes.b: PowerPyx also admits more strands are still being discovered and confirmed.
disputes.call: Bank the four confirmed strands first; treat any new strand as a bonus until the counter moves.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.t: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to unlock the Key Cloner — Randy's Wish List opens after it.
Deliver the Zorrusso during that mission; it is the first car on the list.
Go to the green RK icon west of Vice City to work the list.
Hold Up to scan target cars with WAiNK and check them against the Wish List before stealing.
Hunt the Pegassi row: Vitello, Infernus, Toros and Tempesta.
Hunt the Buckingham pair: Windsor Drop and Jubilee.
Pick up the Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular and Grotti Itali RSX.
Finish with the Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire and Piccia Furia.
Close the list with the Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee and Gallivanter Baller ST-D.
Deliver each car undamaged where you can — good condition pays more.
Check hotel driveways on Vice Beach and Ocean Beach for the rarer models.
Randy's chain is not part of the 100% checklist.
The 16 deliveries pay out as you go — condition bonuses make this chain a solid early money source.

disputes.q: Is the published 16-car list authoritative?
disputes.a: PowerPyx publishes the full 16-car Wish List by name.
disputes.b: Other guides skip the list entirely and point you at Randy's in-game Wish List instead.
disputes.call: Trust the in-game list; use the published names as a hunting checklist.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.t: Play as Jason — Tyrone's chain is Jason-only.
Finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 to open the chain.
Hit the purple Synthetic Lab markers across Vice City and destroy each lab (Take Out Kitty Litter).
Keep clearing labs as new markers appear.
Start the finale, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), when it unlocks.
Shut down the last lab to pop the trophy.
Sweep any lab you pass during other Chapter 3 work — backtracking across Vice City adds up.
Tyrone's chain is not part of the 100% checklist.
Lab locations are all in Vice City — sweep them between Chapter 3 story beats to avoid a dedicated trip.

disputes.q: Does Tyrone's strand count toward Strangers & Freaks?
disputes.a: PowerPyx is explicit: Tyrone's strand does not count toward the 8-strand trophy.
disputes.b: List roundups group Tyrone with the stranger finales, which invites the opposite assumption.
disputes.call: It has its own trophy and adds nothing to the strand counter.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.t: The morning after Down to Earth in Chapter 1, find Lucia in Jason's kitchen.
When she says she is going to meditate, follow her out to the balcony.
Choose Accept and complete the balcony meditation — do not leave Chapter 1 without it.
Make a manual save immediately; there is no mission replay if the window closes.
From Chapter 2, meditate at outdoor spots with both characters — each spot counts +2 when both meditate.
Track progress at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Sweep the remaining marked spots across the 10 locations.
Save the final spot for last — it needs Jason and Lucia together, which opens after Coffee Break.
Stay at each spot until the closing zen animation finishes; leaving early does not register.
If the counter stalls at 17, re-check the Chapter 1 balcony save before assuming a missed outdoor spot.
Meditating with both characters at every spot is also the fastest way to bank the checklist's 15.
Spots show as purple icons when you are close — watch for them during other Chapter 2 work.

disputes.q: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required?
disputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and OutputLag agree: it raises the counter, but nobody has confirmed the trophy requires it.
disputes.b: EGamers notes PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped — correlation, not proof.
disputes.call: Do it. It costs two minutes and removes the only known Platinum risk.

disputes.q: Does the trophy want 18 spots or 15?
disputes.a: The trophy wants all 18 meditation spots meditated at.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18.
disputes.call: 18 for the trophy, 15 for the checklist — do not confuse the two counters.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.t: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, wait for Bret Vogel's text — the chain is Jason-only.
Start with his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County.
Take the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle he gives you; retrieve it later from Ammu-Nation weapon lockers.
Follow the purple hunting markers to each quarry.
Go for clean one-shot kills — pristine carcasses pay more, though payment is not the trophy trigger.
Work the Target Decks from Map > Activities > Target Deck alongside the quests.
Keep hunting Bret's marks until the unique animal goes down and the trophy pops.
All 15 Target Decks are also a checklist requirement, so finish the deck while you are here.
Bret's chain is Jason-only from first text to final deck — do not start it as Lucia.
Study animals through binoculars while you travel to hunts; the checklist wants 100 species.

disputes.q: Which animal triggers the trophy?
disputes.a: PowerPyx walks the whole questline but concedes it is not yet known which animal triggers the trophy.
disputes.b: EGamers and GTA Zone repeat the same gap: the exact animal is unconfirmed.
disputes.call: Finish Bret's entire chain rather than hunting one guessed species.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards to see the 18 sets.
Pick the three sets whose cards cluster closest together and hunt those first.
Collect every card in a set before moving to the next — partial sets do not count.
Sell duplicates at Pawn Shops if you like; sold cards still count toward the set.
Complete any three full sets to pop the trophy.
If the checklist is next, keep going — 100% wants 15 of the 18 sets.
Route card hunts alongside WAiNK scans; the two collectibles share the same map sweeps.
The Progress menu's Collections section shows how close each set is — hunt the nearest set first.
Cards pair with WAiNK scans on the same map sweeps; both are Progress > Collections grinds.

disputes.q: Is the real target 3 sets or 15?
disputes.a: Three complete sets earn the trophy.
disputes.b: The 100% checklist demands 15 of 18 sets, so a trophy-first route leaves 12 sets of debt.
disputes.call: Take the three-set trophy early, but route card hunts as if you will finish 15.

steps.t: Hold Up to open the WAiNK app on either character's phone.
Aim at a point of interest and hold R1 to scan it.
Sweep the Landmarks category first — there are 31 of them.
Work the Curiosities (35) as you cross the map.
Scan the Sculptures (23) in the same sweeps.
Tag No Flusher Tags whenever you spot one — they make up the shortfall past 89.
Check the tally at Touchpad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
Stop at 100 scans; the checklist asks for the same 100, no more.
The checklist asks for the same 100 scans — this trophy and the checklist line finish together.
Scan vehicles between landmarks; traffic scans feed Whip It Good on the same button presses.

disputes.q: Do No Flusher Tags count toward the 100?
disputes.a: PowerPyx lists four scannable categories, including No Flusher Tags, and any mix counts toward 100.
disputes.b: Push Square lists the tag locations without giving their count, leaving the category math open.
disputes.call: Landmarks, Curiosities and Sculptures total 89, so tags must count — scan them.

steps.t: Open Touchpad > Progress > Challenges to see all 80 challenges and their terms.
Let ambient challenges complete themselves as you play — many tick off during other trophies.
Chase the Completed tick, challenge by challenge, starting with the ones nearest done.
Skip the ten nastiest — the trophy needs 50, leaving 30 spare.
If the checklist follows, push to 70 of 80 instead of stopping at 50.
Re-audit the Challenges page after every long session; silent completions are common.
Challenges are the checklist's biggest single time sink after robberies — start them early.
Many challenges complete passively; check the page after every heist, race and hunt session.

disputes.q: Is the target 50 challenges or 70?
disputes.a: Fifty challenges earn the trophy.
disputes.b: Seventy are required for 100% completion.
disputes.call: Treat 70 as the real target on a Platinum run.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.t: Wait until partner free-roam opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Call your partner in: hold Right, then press Triangle.
Commit crimes together until the Wanted Level hits 4 stars.
Break line of sight and leave the red heat zone entirely — clearing the flashing search area is not enough.
Use the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County to shake helicopters.
Stay clean until the heat fully drops with your partner still beside you.
If your partner gets dropped or left behind, regroup before starting the escape — both must get out.
The vault route also feeds Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play — one escape can land three trophies.
Four stars is the ceiling this trophy needs; do not escalate to five while setting it up.

disputes.q: Should you set this up manually or wait for it?
disputes.a: PowerPyx's manual route: raise 4 stars together in free roam, then escape the heat zone.
disputes.b: The same guide notes Chapter 4's vault robberies hand you 4 stars with your partner automatically.
disputes.call: Take the free-roam route in Chapter 2; do not wait for Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.t: Call your partner in after Coffee Break — this chain needs both leads together.
Pack body armor, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline before starting.
Rob the first shop and keep the Wanted Level flashing red and blue — if it fades to the red heat display, the chain breaks.
Hit the second shop without letting the stars drop.
Rob the third shop — the three jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together after Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs.
Loot the back-room safe with sticky bombs if the take is thin.
Wait roughly 30 seconds after the third shop; if nothing pops, rob a fourth.
Healing items matter as much as armor — the chain fails if either partner goes down mid-run.
The same north Vice City jewelry cluster serves Sneakthief if you still need a quiet store.

disputes.q: Why does the trophy sometimes not pop after the third shop?
disputes.a: The description reads as three shops, full stop.
disputes.b: PowerPyx and OutputLag both warn the pop can lag about 30 seconds, and a fourth robbery is the field fix.
disputes.call: Rob three, wait, then rob a fourth before assuming it failed.

steps.t: Hold Up to raise WAiNK, then hold R1 to scan any vehicle you have not logged.
Stand on a busy road and scan traffic as it passes — entering the car is not required.
Sweep parking lots and hotel driveways for models that never spawn in traffic.
Audit the count at Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
Scan as you story-run from Chapter 1 — early scanning saves a long cleanup drive.
Keep scanning past 100 — the checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models.
You will pass 100 scans naturally on the way to the checklist's 200 — do not grind this one separately.
New models cluster at airports, marinas and rich districts; sweep those lots when traffic repeats itself.

disputes.q: Does scanning a vehicle really count as discovering it?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTA Zone: a WAiNK scan alone discovers the vehicle; no driving needed.
disputes.b: Push Square phrases discovery as getting inside a vehicle or scanning one.
disputes.call: Scan-only is confirmed by two guides — scan everything, drive what you like.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.t: Build your Focus first: eat, drink, wash your face or shower to top the meter up.
Take an Adrenaline shot (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the Focus window.
Pick a Gang Operation with clustered guards as your stage.
Equip an assault rifle such as the Duke 556 and wear body armor.
Aim, then press L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus and slow time.
Drop five gang enemies before the effect ends — weak spots glow while Focus runs.
Raise Focus levels at ranges, golf, pool and fishing if the window feels too short.
Land headshots during normal play to keep the Focus stat climbing between attempts.
Shooting-range sessions raise Focus, so grind Shootist medals before attempting this if the window feels short.
Combat Focus is also the safest way to clear gang operations for Pest Control — practice there.

disputes.q: Which targets count for the five takedowns?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and EGamers warn it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians — gang enemies only.
disputes.b: The trophy text and most lists just say '5 enemies' with no restriction printed.
disputes.call: Only trust gang-operation targets.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.t: Head to Vice City International Airport and find a large passenger jet docked at a departure gate.
Use gates E3 or E4 — airfield-parked planes do not count.
Go through the fence, open the stairs door beside the boarding bridge and climb up.
Enter the cockpit from the bridge level.
Back the jet out, taxi to the runway and take off.
Fly about a kilometre away and wait for the delayed pop.
Save before you start — airport police respond fast.
The airport is also the stage for the Hi-Jacked story mission — learn the fence lines during Chapter 4.
A Pay 'n' Spray visit after takeoff is a valid way to bleed the wanted level once you land.

disputes.q: Will any plane at the airport do?
disputes.a: PowerPyx is specific: only a jet docked at a boarding bridge counts.
disputes.b: GamesFuze's looser wording — 'an unscheduled departure from VCIA' — could be read as any plane at the airport.
disputes.call: Use a gate-docked jet at E3 or E4; do not gamble on airfield planes.

steps.t: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the map's south-west edge, in Mariana County.
Enter through the main gate, or stunt-jump the fence by the south-east entrance.
Find the Rhino tanks parked at the south end of the base.
Climb in and start engaging the base's soldiers from the tank.
Keep firing until the trophy pops — a plain joyride is not the method.
Save before entering; the base response is heavy.
The base sits on the southwest island of Mariana County — pair the trip with Goodtime State fog clearing nearby.
Tank fire also feeds Criminal Profile actions for Actions Speak Louder.

disputes.q: Is stealing the tank enough on its own?
disputes.a: PowerPyx's method: get in a Rhino and take out enemies from inside it until it pops.
disputes.b: GTAScoop's one-liner says only 'steal a military tank', with no combat step.
disputes.call: Steal it and fight in it — the combat reading covers both.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.t: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to receive the Snap Gun.
Pick a jewelry store — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a clean target.
Go to the back door and pick it silently with the Snap Gun; never kick it in — that trips the alarm.
Search the back room for the note carrying the safe code.
Open and empty the safe.
Destroy the security footage and disable the alarm on your way out.
Leave unseen; the trophy unlocks shortly after you exit.
If someone spots you, reload the pre-entry save instead of fighting — detection voids the run.
The Snap Gun works on the back door only — front entrances are not silent entries.
Jewelry fences well; sell the take toward Dime on the Dollar's fence totals afterwards.

disputes.q: Are the cameras and alarm part of the method?
disputes.a: PowerPyx's full method includes wiping the security footage and disabling the alarm.
disputes.b: OutputLag's shorter method stops at the safe code and an unseen exit.
disputes.call: Do the full routine — the extra steps cost seconds.

steps.t: In Chapter 4, take the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
Tail the security van to the bank and follow the guard carrying the briefcase inside.
Enter the vault while it stands open and start bagging cash.
Hand a bag to your partner — the haul is too heavy to carry solo.
Expect an instant 4-star Wanted Level; escape on a fast bike, then swap vehicles.
Afterwards, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 — he sells them once his own jobs, including two Payday Loans, are done.
Repeat until five vaults are emptied and escaped.
For the checklist, finish all eight large bank jobs, worth up to $205,000 each.
Each vault also hands you the 4 stars Hot Together needs — route the two trophies together.
Vault cash is the run's biggest income: it funds Little Boxes and Treat Yo Self in one stroke.

disputes.q: Is the target five vaults or eight?
disputes.a: Five vaults earn the trophy.
disputes.b: All eight vaults are required for 100% completion.
disputes.call: Rob all eight on a Platinum run; the trophy lands at five.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.t: Fastest route: let a Chapter 4 bank vault job earn this for you automatically.
For the manual route, watch for a roaming armored truck near banks.
Block the truck with your vehicle so it cannot drive off.
Blow the rear doors with sticky bombs — buy them at Yasmani's shop after his jobs.
Grab the cash and break out of the red heat radius completely.
Stay hidden until the Wanted Level clears.
If the truck escapes, re-route to the nearest bank and wait for the next delivery run.
Treat any vault job you already plan for Maximum Withdrawal as the primary attempt.
Escaping to a Pay 'n' Spray also satisfies the escape condition — you do not have to outrun the heat zone every time.
Armored trucks also appear as part of vault setups, so Chapter 4 gives repeated natural attempts.

disputes.q: Does a bank vault job really earn a truck trophy?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTA Zone both say a bank vault robbery counts toward this trophy on its own.
disputes.b: The trophy text names an armored truck, and PowerPyx still documents the truck method in full.
disputes.call: Take the vault route if it pops; keep the truck method as the fallback.

steps.t: Do this late: story travel will already have cleared most of the mainland for free.
Take a plane up and fly every patch of black fog on the map.
Work county by county so no fog pocket survives behind you.
Drop low over islands and the Keys — high passes can leave thin fog behind.
Re-check the map after each flight until no dark areas remain.
Sweep the far corners by boat where flight paths leave coastal fog untouched.
Confirm the pop only when the map renders fully clear at maximum zoom-out.
Exploration progress is safest checked on the map itself — zoom fully out and look for any dark patch.
Boats clear the Keys and coast fog that flight paths can skip.

disputes.q: Does 'explore all' just mean clearing the map fog?
disputes.a: Guides equate the trophy with clearing the map fog, fastest from the air.
disputes.b: The description's word 'explore' leaves open whether ground discovery is needed anywhere.
disputes.call: Unfog everything from the air first; only ground-check any region that refuses to clear.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.t: Filter the map for the yellow Illegal Operation icons.
Open Progress > Gangs to see the nine gangs and which you have hit.
Rob one operation belonging to the first gang on the list.
Move gang by gang — a second operation for the same gang does not advance this trophy.
Loot each operation's valuables while you are inside; you will be back for the checklist otherwise.
Use these crowds to practice Combat Focus takedowns for Gunslinger between robberies.
Stop at one per gang for the trophy.
On a Platinum run, continue to all 39 operations for the checklist.
The wider robbery board also includes Smash 'N' Grabs (34 of 35) and Stick Ups (50 of 91) on the checklist — sweep them between gang jobs.
Gang operations are the checklist's single biggest robbery block: all 39 are required in full.

disputes.q: Is the target 9 operations or 39?
disputes.a: One operation per gang — nine in total — earns the trophy.
disputes.b: The checklist wants all 39 gang operations cleared.
disputes.call: Hit one per gang early for the trophy, then sweep the rest under the checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.t: Travel to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Walk up to the bar and buy an Apple Martini.
Stay standing next to the bar and drink it there — do not wander off with it.
Wait a moment at the rail for the trophy to register.
If it refuses, retry at a different time of day before writing the method off.
Try the second character as well; some one-off feats are character-sensitive.
Park this in cleanup — nothing about it is missable.
Ocean Beach is early-game ground — try this on any Vice Beach visit rather than a dedicated trip.

disputes.q: Are the exact steps for this one actually known?
disputes.a: PowerPyx gives exact steps: an Apple Martini, bought and drunk at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar.
disputes.b: GTABase and GTAScoop both mark the exact steps as not yet confirmed.
disputes.call: Follow the specific method — it is the only concrete one published — but treat the trophy as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.t: Unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS) before attempting this.
Go to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City.
Find the specific blue Banshee on the showroom floor — other cars do not count.
Use the Key Cloner to hack into the Banshee.
Drive it straight out through the showroom window.
Expect a delayed pop once you are clear of the building.
If nothing pops, confirm you took the blue Banshee and not another showroom car, then retry.
The showroom exit is a deliberate GTA III homage — the window, not the door, is the way out.

disputes.q: How certain is the blue Banshee method?
disputes.a: PowerPyx names the car and the tool: the blue Banshee, opened with the Key Cloner, out through the window.
disputes.b: GTABase marks the exact steps unconfirmed and reads the trophy as a GTA III homage.
disputes.call: The specific-car method is the only actionable one; follow it exactly.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.t: Head to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — it runs as a gang operation.
Bring sticky bombs before you go in.
Take the luxury watch from the office in the south-east.
Pick up the unique shotgun, the Gutterball Moreland 850, on the table in the north-east corner.
Blow the safe in the north-east hallway office with sticky bombs and loot it.
Escape the police response to close the job out.
Missed one? Return later — the valuables respawn, though slowly, and it need not be a single visit.
Count this operation toward Pest Control's gang sweep while you are here.
This operation counts toward Pest Control's nine-gang sweep as well.
The robbery takes a long time to come back, so a missed valuable means a long wait, not a quick retry.

disputes.q: Could this one be missable inside a Chapter 2 mission?
disputes.a: PowerPyx states plainly: not missable, and the three valuables need not be taken in one visit.
disputes.b: Because it sits inside a Chapter 2 optional mission, list-only readers could reasonably fear a one-shot window; no list confirms one.
disputes.call: Not missable — but grab all three valuables on the first visit anyway.

steps.t: Wait until partner play opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Call your partner in before training — the partner auto-trains alongside you for double progress.
Find fitness clubs via Map > Activities and work out there together.
After the story, home workouts count too.
Check both Strength meters at Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon).
Keep alternating characters until both meters sit at maximum at the same time.
Do not let one character's meter decay while you grind the other — train as a pair throughout.
Strength also grows through ordinary play; gyms simply make it deliberate and paired.
Train during Chapter 2's partner era so both meters climb before the endgame rush.

disputes.q: What does 'mass appeal' actually mean?
disputes.a: GTABase decodes the riddle: max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia.
disputes.b: Several lists print only the riddle text and offer no decoding at all.
disputes.call: The Strength reading is consistent across the guides that attempt one — train both.

steps.t: Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile so actions report as they happen.
Play naturally — robberies, fights and escapes all feed the counter.
Watch which profile you are drifting toward: Professional, Hardened, Violent or Psycho.
Never push toward Irredeemable — that profile is permanent.
If the count lags late-game, farm profile actions with repeatable free-roam crimes.
Check the running total until it passes 500 actions.
Keep the profile varied; no single profile type is required for the trophy.
Most players earn this without trying — check the count before planning any farm.
Profile notifications live in Settings > UI — turn them on in Chapter 1, not in cleanup.

disputes.q: Is the requirement really 500 actions?
disputes.a: GTABase puts the requirement at 500 Criminal Profile actions.
disputes.b: EGamers flags that figure as single-source — no second guide confirms the number.
disputes.call: Work to 500; if it pops earlier, the single source was conservative.

steps.t: Keep a manual save from the Prologue — the leading theory points back there.
Return to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, in Little Cuba.
Try robbing that store again in free roam and watch for the pop.
If nothing triggers, retry feats you failed once — the description hints at a second attempt.
Log each attempt you make; the trigger is unsolved and your notes are the method for now.
Do not burn hours here mid-run; park it for cleanup.
Revisit after patches and guide updates — this is the list's known unknown.
Every other unconfirmed trophy on the list has a working method; this is the one to leave for last.

disputes.q: Does anyone actually know how this unlocks?
disputes.a: PowerPyx's theory: it involves the Prologue's Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, robbed again in a specific way.
disputes.b: GTABase reads the description literally — succeeding at something on a second attempt — while KeenGamer and GTAScoop list the method as simply not known.
disputes.call: Genuinely unsolved. Try the Payday Loans theory first; it is the only concrete lead.

steps.t: Go alone, at night, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Arrive after 2AM and look for a car blinking at the roadside.
If no car is there, drive away and return until it spawns.
Follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light.
Reach the woman the UFO dropped and talk to her.
Accept her request for help and walk her back to her car at the roadside.
The trophy should pop as she reaches the car.
Bring no partner and no wanted level — the encounter is scripted for a solo arrival.
If the encounter is real, it is the list's only true Easter-egg trophy — the rest all have mechanical triggers.

disputes.q: Is the UFO encounter confirmed or folklore?
disputes.a: PowerPyx publishes a complete step-by-step UFO encounter at the Starlet Motel.
disputes.b: KeenGamer and EGamers still file this trophy under 'unlock method unconfirmed'.
disputes.call: Run the encounter exactly — solo, after 2AM — but know it is one source's account.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.t: Take any motorcycle into a crowded area — Vice City or Ocean Beach pavements work.
Ride along the pavement at moderate speed.
Press Square to kick pedestrians as you pass them.
Chain 10 knockdowns inside 60 seconds.
If the trophy does not pop, restart in a denser crowd rather than a faster one.
Expect a wanted level; finish the chain before the police box you in.
Count your kicks out loud — there is no on-screen counter for this one.
However it resolves, the trigger involves a vehicle melee — practice bike kicks during Pest Control runs.

disputes.q: What is the precise Ten Pin method?
disputes.a: PowerPyx's method: 10 pedestrian kicks from a bike within 60 seconds.
disputes.b: KeenGamer says the precise method is still being confirmed, and GTAScoop lists it as not known yet.
disputes.call: The bike-kick method fits the description best; treat the 60-second window as the working rule.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.t: Finish Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 to receive the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans stores — their takes include Marked Bills.
Deliver Marked Bills to a Fence contact to launder them.
Route deliveries through Yasmani where you can — he pays the most for them.
Remember the target is cumulative: $250,000 across the whole run, not in one delivery.
Use Chapter 4's vault hauls (up to $205,000 a bank) to close most of the distance at once.
Keep fencing after every robbery spree instead of stockpiling bills.
Check the fenced total against the checklist's matching $250,000 line — they are the same grind.
The checklist carries matching fence totals: $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry and $200,000 vehicles alongside the marked bills.
Payday Loan jobs (7 for the checklist) are the steadiest early source of marked bills.

disputes.q: Must the bills go through Yasmani specifically?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and GTA Zone both say Yasmani pays the most for Marked Bills.
disputes.b: The trophy text only says 'through your contacts' — any Fence launders them.
disputes.call: Any contact counts toward the total; Yasmani just gets you there faster.

steps.t: Spend as you play — the $100,000 is a running total across every shop type.
Push the total fastest with guns at Ammu-Nation — 24 stores statewide.
Add car upgrades at the 14 mod shops and resprays at the 19 Pay 'n' Sprays.
Top up with clothing (67 stores), footwear (17) and hair & beauty (18).
Finish the census with tattoo studios (11) and electronics stores (15).
Filter the map by Touchpad > Style to find shop types you have not used.
Stop counting at $100,000 — the trophy tracks the cumulative spend for you.
Garage purchases do not count here — this is shop spending only, so Little Boxes money does not advance it.
Weapon and vehicle upgrades you buy for other grinds all count — spend with the run, not against it.

disputes.q: What is the smart way to spend the $100,000?
disputes.a: PowerPyx's route: guns, car mods and tattoos burn the total down quickest.
disputes.b: Push Square leaves it open — 'exactly how you spend the money is up to you'.
disputes.call: Both are right; spend on things your run needs anyway.

steps.t: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock property buying.
Press Up and open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Buy Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000) and the Persistence Road Garage ($7,600) first.
Add the 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800).
Buy Wyatt Motors ($21,600) and the Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000).
Finish with Bonita Court Garage ($34,000) and Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) — $160,000 in total.
Ignore the four story garages; they never count toward this trophy.
Fund the purchases with robbery takes rather than grinding jobs — vault money arrives in Chapter 4.
Each garage is a single parking spot — eight garages means eight stored vehicles for On the Spot.
Buy garages before registering vehicles; registration refuses without a free slot.

disputes.q: Do the four story garages count toward 'all garage properties'?
disputes.a: Every guide that names a number says eight purchasable garages, with the four story garages excluded.
disputes.b: The trophy text says 'all garage properties', which on its face could include the story ones.
disputes.call: Eight purchases, $160,000 — the story garages are free and do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) to install the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garage space first — a vehicle cannot register without a free slot.
Drive a stolen, tracker-free vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Choose Respray, then Register, to bind the car to the app.
From Chapter 3, register tracked cars at any Pay 'n' Spray instead.
Register cheap cars and bikes — the fee scales with the vehicle's value.
Repeat until ten vehicles sit in the app.
Call a registered vehicle out once to confirm the app round-trips before grinding the rest.
Registered vehicles can be delivered to you by Scooter Bros for a small fee — register cars you actually drive.
Moses is in Port Gellhorn — pair registration trips with Rodgers Ranch range sessions nearby.

disputes.q: Where and when can vehicles be registered?
disputes.a: PowerPyx and OutputLag: registration starts at Moses, and tracked cars only become registerable from Chapter 3.
disputes.b: Push Square says vehicles can be registered at a Pay 'n' Spray or Mod Shop 'at any time' with a free slot.
disputes.call: Moses first; Pay 'n' Spray registration is a Chapter 3 convenience.
